test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The announcer requested the audience to switch off their mobile phones for the next two hours.

options.text: The announcer said to the audience, “You all switch off your mobile phones for the next two hours.”
The announcer said to the audience, “Please switch off your mobile phones for the next two hours.”
The announcer told the audience, “You have to switch off your mobile phones for the next two hours.”
The announcer said to the audience, “You can switch off your mobile phones for the next two hours.”

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The rules of changing Indirect to Direct speech for imperative sentence conversions.

 
 
• **"Requested"** is changed to **"said to."**
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• Imperative sentences do not normally have an expressed subject.
 
• This is because the subject ‘you’ is usually understood.
 
• The phrase **"to switch off their mobile phones"** remains the same in both indirect and direct speech.
 
• The word **"please"** is added in the direct speech version to convey politeness and make it a request rather than a command.
 
• In order to change an imperative sentence into direct speech, we must remove a to-infinitive from direct speech.
 
 
• Example: 
 
• *The old woman said to the boy, ‘Go to the auditorium.’*
 
• *The old woman ordered the boy to go to the auditorium.*
 
 
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence: *The announcer said to the audience, "Please switch off your mobile phones for the next two hours."*
